from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from shared state
        title_text = "The Mathematical Recipe (The Formula)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "The formula calculates the probability of exactly k successes.",
            "'n choose k' counts the different ways to succeed.",
            "'p' to the 'k' represents the successes' probability.",
            "'1 minus p' to the 'n-k' represents failures.",
            "Combine these parts to find the total probability."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Initial state: all lecture lines gray except the first (to be highlighted)
        self.lecture.set_color("#808080")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Script: The formula calculates the probability of exactly k successes.
        # Storyboard: [self.wait(2.0)] Fade in formula: P(X=k) = nCk * p^k * (1-p)^(n-k).
        
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.wait(2.0)
        
        # Build formula. Using \cdot to represent the '*' from storyboard for clarity.
        # Parts: 0:P(X=k), 1:=, 2:nCk, 3:\cdot, 4:p^k, 5:\cdot, 6:(1-p)^{n-k}
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(X=k)", "=", "nCk", "\\cdot", "p^k", "\\cdot", "(1-p)^{n-k}",
            font_size=42
        )
        # Center formula in the upper-middle right area
        self.place_in_area(formula, "C2", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(formula))
        self.wait(1.0) # Buffer wait after animation

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Script: 'n choose k' counts the different ways to succeed.
        # Storyboard: [self.wait(1.5)] Color 'nCk' Magenta (#FF00FF) and label it 'Combinations'.
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#808080"),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF00FF")
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        label_comb = Text("Combinations", font_size=24, color="#FF00FF")
        # Position label above the nCk part (around C3)
        self.place_at_grid(label_comb, "B3", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(
            formula[2].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"),
            Write(label_comb)
        )
        self.wait(1.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Script: 'p' to the 'k' represents the successes' probability.
        # Storyboard: [self.wait(1.5)] Color 'p^k' Cyan (#00FFFF) and label 'Success Prob'.
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#808080"),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00FFFF")
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        label_succ = Text("Success Prob", font_size=24, color="#00FFFF")
        # Position below the p^k part (around C4)
        self.place_at_grid(label_succ, "D4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(
            formula[4].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            Write(label_succ)
        )
        self.wait(1.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Script: '1 minus p' to the 'n-k' represents failures.
        # Storyboard: [self.wait(1.5)] Color '(1-p)^(n-k)' Yellow (#FFFF00) and label 'Failure Prob'.
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#808080"),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#FFFF00")
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        label_fail = Text("Failure Prob", font_size=24, color="#FFFF00")
        # Position below the (1-p) part (around C6)
        self.place_at_grid(label_fail, "D6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(
            formula[6].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"),
            Write(label_fail)
        )
        self.wait(1.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Script: Combine these parts to find the total probability.
        # Storyboard: [self.wait(2.0)] Morph variables into values: 10C7 * 0.7^7 * 0.3^3.
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#808080"),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF")
        )
        self.wait(2.0)
        
        # Concrete values: 10 attempts, 7 successes, p=0.7, (1-p)=0.3
        val_formula = MathTex(
            "P(X=7)", "=", "10C7", "\\cdot", "0.7^7", "\\cdot", "0.3^3",
            font_size=42
        )
        self.place_in_area(val_formula, "C2", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Match colors for the morph
        val_formula[2].set_color("#FF00FF")
        val_formula[4].set_color("#00FFFF")
        val_formula[6].set_color("#FFFF00")
        
        # Morph variables into concrete values while clearing labels for clarity
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(formula, val_formula),
            FadeOut(label_comb, label_succ, label_fail)
        )
        self.wait(3.0) # Final absorption time

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Background and Title setup
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color="#FFFFFF").to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content logic
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color="#FFFFFF") for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define 6x6 grid system for visual placement on the right half
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset grid to the right side of the screen
                x = 1.0 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        """Helper to place mobjects on the defined A1-F6 grid."""
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        if grid_pos in self.grid:
            mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # Implementation for Section 3: Understanding Binomial Distributions
        self.setup_layout(
            "Understanding Binomial Distributions", 
            [
                "- Fixed number of trials (n)",
                "- Success or Failure outcomes",
                "- Constant probability (p)",
                "- Independent trials"
            ]
        )
        
        # Represent the PMF formula
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(X=k) = \\binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}",
            font_size=34,
            color="#00FFFF"
        )
        # Position using the grid system
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "C3", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        # Visual indicator for success/failure (Binary outcome)
        success_dot = Dot(color="#00FF00", radius=0.2)
        failure_dot = Dot(color="#FF0000", radius=0.2)
        
        self.place_at_grid(success_dot, "E2")
        self.place_at_grid(failure_dot, "E4")
        
        success_label = Text("Success", font_size=20).next_to(success_dot, DOWN)
        failure_label = Text("Failure", font_size=20).next_to(failure_dot, DOWN)

        # Animations
        self.play(FadeIn(self.title))
        self.play(Create(self.lecture, run_time=2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.play(Indicate(formula, color="#FF00FF"))
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(success_dot, shift=UP),
            FadeIn(failure_dot, shift=UP),
            Write(success_label),
            Write(failure_label)
        )
        
        # Highlight independent trials concept
        highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(self.lecture[3], color="#FFFF00")
        self.play(Create(highlight_box))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(highlight_box), FadeOut(success_dot), FadeOut(failure_dot), FadeOut(success_label), FadeOut(failure_label))
        self.wait(1)
